title: Beware Escapism
coreMove: Rest is honest when it returns you with more capacity for life; escape only lowers the noise while the duty, fear, or grief waits.

exampleSpecs.domain: sports betting feed before rent call
exampleSpecs.audience: people mistaking a numbing feed for rest
exampleSpecs.stakes: catch escape before it gathers momentum
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Marek labels the feed false rest before the hard call is missed

exampleSpecs.domain: home repair videos before sink fix
exampleSpecs.audience: people choosing between comfort and the truth waiting beside them
exampleSpecs.stakes: use the storm triad to separate running from steady action
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Alina makes the call from beside the leak instead of hiding in videos

exampleSpecs.domain: game loop before hard phone call
exampleSpecs.audience: people testing whether a break returns capacity
exampleSpecs.stakes: separate quiet posture from actual recovery
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Gabe tests the game loop by whether he can make the call afterward

exampleSpecs.audience: people believing one more feed session will make the next task lighter
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Noemi sees the feed made the apology heavier

exampleSpecs.audience: people making comfort wait behind truth
exampleSpecs.stakes: keep self-care language from hiding avoidance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Hector sends the apology before taking the promised break

exampleSpecs.audience: people whose interruptions can become escape
exampleSpecs.stakes: keep contact with the live task while pressure is present
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Iris restarts at the letter instead of chasing the alert
